segments: Leo sat at the kitchen table, surrounded by job applications. His small family home felt very busy. Finding work was hard. Dirty dishes piled up, and laundry baskets overflowed. endWrap: Leo found success and brought harmony to his home. His journey shows how technology can solve problems and help families thrive together.
